locality.name: De Beers Pool
locality.notes: Pooled run-of-mine production of four Kimberley mines (De Beers, Du Toit's Pan, Bultfontein, Wesselton); the mine of any single diamond is not reported. No coordinates entered yet (Phase 6 gazetteer).

evidence.excerpt: pooled run-of-mine production from the De Beers, Du Toit’s Pan, Bultfontein and Wesselton (De Beers Pool) mines

epma.conditions: Cameca SX-50, De Beers Geoscience Centre; 20 kV, 20 nA; PAP matrix correction; 40 s peak and 10 s background counting; Na2O and K2O detection limits typically 0.02 wt%. Inclusions released by crushing or cleaving the diamond and mounted in epoxy.
epma.spot_label: average of at least three analyses, core to rim

evidence.excerpt: electron microprobe compositions are reported as averaged values of at least three analyses per inclusion
